response.answer: A protected review hour lets auditors examine contested denials without routine interruptions, because those cases can carry appeal risk and require careful review. Routine queue questions can be held and summarized afterward while the queue continues moving; only urgent or legally significant matters—such as vulnerable-customer escalations, regulator requests, or data-security issues—should interrupt the block.
